svg.aria-label: Deckhand opening picture: the Deckhand bollard icon and wordmark with the AceEngineer wordmark; the Deckhand icon grips a rope that traces offshore project cost, the capital blend, from 2000 to 2025, beside a dotted line for consumer prices, over three pale bands named boom, bust and boom, up to the crane of a semi-submersible platform drawn close at sea; the title Offshore mega-project cost inflation over time
